annotations.title: Search Hark Tech's printable model catalogue

description:
Search Printables and Thingiverse models that Hark Tech can print and price.

    Only models whose licence allows commercial printing are returned, plus
    Hark Tech's own complete kits when the query names an appliance they fit
    (those carry fits, includes, not_included and route fields; a
    personal_use_copy route means one copy for the person's own use, ordered
    on the model_link page). Each result has a title, designer, thumbnail
    and model_link. Use when the person wants a ready-made model printed.

    Args:
        query: What the person wants, e.g. "phone stand", "cable clip", "Dyson V15 trigger".
        page: Results page, 10 per page.
name: search_models
